---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AHF == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems

\* Sequence shape suffices for the configuration-bookkeeping invariant.
AHSeq(q) == \E S : q \in Seq(S)

LEMMA AHSeqFacts ==
  \A q : AHSeq(q) => Len(q) \in Nat
BY LenProperties, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq

LEMMA AHEmpty == AHSeq(<<>>) /\ Len(<<>>) = 0
BY EmptySeq, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq

LEMMA AHSubSeq ==
  \A q, a, b : a \in Int /\ b \in Int => AHSeq(SubSeq(q,a,b))
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
      PROVE AHSeq(SubSeq(q,a,b))
  <2>1. SubSeq(q,a,b) \in Seq({q[k] : k \in a..b})
    BY <1>1, SubSeqProperties, SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. QED BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHConcat ==
  \A q, r : AHSeq(q) /\ AHSeq(r) => AHSeq(q \o r)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, NEW r, AHSeq(q), AHSeq(r)
      PROVE AHSeq(q \o r)
  <2>1. PICK S, T : q \in Seq(S) /\ r \in Seq(T)
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq
  <2>2. q \in Seq(S \cup T) /\ r \in Seq(S \cup T)
    BY <1>1, <2>1, SeqMonotonic, SMTT("r1")
  <2>3. q \o r \in Seq(S \cup T)
    BY <1>1, <2>2, ConcatProperties, SMTT("r1")
  <2>4. QED BY <1>1, <2>3, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHAppend ==
  \A q, x : AHSeq(q) =>
    /\ AHSeq(Append(q,x))
    /\ Len(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
    /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,x)[k] = q[k]
    /\ Append(q,x)[Len(q)+1] = x
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, NEW x, AHSeq(q)
      PROVE /\ AHSeq(Append(q,x))
            /\ Len(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
            /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,x)[k] = q[k]
            /\ Append(q,x)[Len(q)+1] = x
  <2>1. PICK S : q \in Seq(S) BY <1>1, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq
  <2>2. q \in Seq(S \cup {x}) BY <1>1, <2>1, SeqMonotonic, SMTT("r1")
  <2>3. QED BY <1>1, <2>2, AppendProperties, SMTT("r1") DEF AHSeq
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHMaximum ==
  \A S : IsFiniteSet(S) /\ S \subseteq Nat /\ S # {} =>
    /\ SetMax(S) \in S
    /\ \A k \in S : k <= SetMax(S)
<1>1. \A S : IsFiniteSet(S) <=> AHF!IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY SMTT("r1") DEF IsFiniteSet, AHF!IsFiniteSet
<1>2. \A S : SetMax(S) = AHF!Max(S)
  BY Isa DEF SetMax, AHF!Max
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AHF!MaxIntFinite, SMTT("r2")

LEMMA AHConfigFacts ==
  \A q : AHSeq(q) =>
    /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q)
    /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in 0..LastConfigIndex(q)
    /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
    /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
          k <= PreviousConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, AHSeq(q)
      PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q)
            /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in 0..LastConfigIndex(q)
            /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
            /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
                  k <= PreviousConfigIndex(q)
  <2>1. Len(q) \in Nat BY <1>1, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. IsFiniteSet(ConfigIndices(q))
    BY <1>1, <2>1, FS_Interval, FS_Subset, SMTT("r2") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>3. IsFiniteSet(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
    BY <1>1, <2>2, FS_RemoveElement, SMTT("r1")
  <2>4. ConfigIndices(q) \subseteq Nat
    BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r1") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>5. ConfigIndices(q) # {} =>
          /\ SetMax(ConfigIndices(q)) \in ConfigIndices(q)
          /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= SetMax(ConfigIndices(q))
    BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>4, AHMaximum, SMTT("r1")
  <2>6. LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q) /\
          \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>5, SMTT("r2") DEF ConfigIndices, LastConfigIndex
  <2>7. ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} # {} =>
          /\ SetMax(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
                 \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)}
          /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
                 k <= SetMax(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
    BY <1>1, <2>3, <2>4, AHMaximum, SMTT("r1")
  <2>8. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>6, <2>7, SMTT("r2") DEF ConfigIndices, PreviousConfigIndex
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHValueAppend ==
  \A q, x : AHSeq(q) /\ x.type # ConfigEntry =>
    /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
    /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = PreviousConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, NEW x, AHSeq(q), x.type # ConfigEntry
      PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
            /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = PreviousConfigIndex(q)
  <2>1. ConfigIndices(Append(q,x)) = ConfigIndices(q)
    BY <1>1, AHAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r2") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>2. QED BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r1") DEF LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHConfigAppend ==
  \A q, x : AHSeq(q) /\ x.type = ConfigEntry =>
    /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
    /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, NEW x, AHSeq(q), x.type = ConfigEntry
      PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
            /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = LastConfigIndex(q)
  <2>1. ConfigIndices(Append(q,x)) = ConfigIndices(q) \cup {Len(q)+1}
    BY <1>1, AHAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r2") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>2. LastConfigIndex(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
    BY <1>1, <2>1, AHAppend, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r2")
  <2>3. ConfigIndices(Append(q,x)) \ {LastConfigIndex(Append(q,x))}
          = ConfigIndices(q)
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r2") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>4. QED BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1") DEF PreviousConfigIndex, LastConfigIndex
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHMerge ==
  \A q, r, p : AHSeq(q) /\ AHSeq(r) /\ p \in Nat =>
    AHSeq(MergeEntries(q,p,r))
<1>1. ASSUME NEW q, NEW r, NEW p \in Nat, AHSeq(q), AHSeq(r)
      PROVE AHSeq(MergeEntries(q,p,r))
  <2>1. Len(q) \in Nat /\ Len(r) \in Nat BY <1>1, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. CASE Len(r) = 0
    BY <1>1, <2>2, SMTT("r1") DEF MergeEntries
  <2>3. CASE Len(r) # 0
    <3>1. DEFINE B == {k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
                        k = Len(r)+1 \/ p+k > Len(q) \/ q[p+k].term # r[k].term}
    <3>2. B \subseteq Nat /\ B # {}
      <4>1. Len(r)+1 \in B
        BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r1") DEF B
      <4>2. QED BY <4>1, <2>1, SMTT("r1") DEF B
    <3>3. AHF!Min(B) \in B /\ \A k \in B : AHF!Min(B) <= k
      BY <1>1, <2>3, <3>2, AHF!MinNat, SMTT("r1")
    <3>4. \E k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
            /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
                /\ p+j <= Len(q)
                /\ q[p+j].term = r[j].term
            /\ k = Len(r)+1 \/ p+k > Len(q) \/ q[p+k].term # r[k].term
      BY <1>1, <2>3, <2>1, <3>3, SMTT("r2") DEF B
    <3>5. DEFINE AHFirst == MergeEntries(q,p,r)!3!firstNew
    <3>5a. HIDE DEF AHFirst
    <3>6. AHFirst \in 1..(Len(r)+1)
      BY <1>1, <2>3, <3>4, SMTT("r1") DEF AHFirst
    <3>7. AHSeq(SubSeq(q,1,p+AHFirst-1)) /\ AHSeq(SubSeq(r,AHFirst,Len(r)))
      BY <1>1, <2>3, <3>6, <2>1, AHSubSeq, SMTT("r2")
    <3>8. AHSeq(SubSeq(q,1,p+AHFirst-1) \o SubSeq(r,AHFirst,Len(r)))
      BY <1>1, <2>3, <3>7, AHConcat, SMTT("r1")
    <3>9. QED BY <1>1, <2>3, <3>8, Zenon DEF MergeEntries, AHFirst
  <2>4. QED BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

AHMessage(m) ==
  /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesRequest =>
        /\ AHSeq(m.mentries)
        /\ m.mprevLogIndex \in Nat
        /\ m.mcommitIndex \in Nat)
  /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesResponse => m.mmatchIndex \in Nat)

\* Every server retains a configuration boundary at or beyond its
\* penultimate configuration entry.  The remaining clauses supply the
\* sequence and index types needed to preserve that boundary.
AHInv ==
  /\ log = [s \in Server |-> log[s]]
  /\ \A s \in Server : AHSeq(log[s])
  /\ commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ nextIndex \in [Server -> [Server -> (Nat \ {0})]]
  /\ latestConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ committedConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ \A s \in Server :
       /\ latestConfigIndex[s] = LastConfigIndex(log[s])
       /\ PreviousConfigIndex(log[s]) <= committedConfigIndex[s]
  /\ \A m \in DOMAIN messages : AHMessage(m)

LEMMA AHInit == Init => AHInv
BY AHEmpty, SMTT("r2")
DEF Init, ProtocolInit, AHInv, EmptyBag, SetToBag,
    ConfigIndices, LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex

LEMMA AHMsgKinds ==
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesRequest
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
  /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesRequest
  /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesResponse
  /\ AppendEntriesRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
<1>1. DEFINE AHK1 == {RequestVoteRequest}
             AHK2 == AHK1 \cup {RequestVoteResponse}
             AHK3 == AHK2 \cup {AppendEntriesRequest}
             AHK4 == AHK3 \cup {AppendEntriesResponse}
<1>2. IsFiniteSet(AHK1) /\ Cardinality(AHK1) = 1
  BY FS_Singleton, SMTT("r1") DEF AHK1
<1>3. IsFiniteSet(AHK2) /\ Cardinality(AHK2) =
          IF RequestVoteResponse \in AHK1 THEN 1 ELSE 2
  BY <1>2, FS_AddElement, SMTT("r1") DEF AHK2
<1>4. IsFiniteSet(AHK3) /\ Cardinality(AHK3) =
          IF AppendEntriesRequest \in AHK2 THEN Cardinality(AHK2) ELSE Cardinality(AHK2)+1
  BY <1>3, FS_AddElement, SMTT("r1") DEF AHK3
<1>5. Cardinality(AHK4) =
          IF AppendEntriesResponse \in AHK3 THEN Cardinality(AHK3) ELSE Cardinality(AHK3)+1
  BY <1>4, FS_AddElement, SMTT("r1") DEF AHK4
<1>5a. AHK4 = {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse, AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}
  BY SMTT("r1") DEF AHK1, AHK2, AHK3, AHK4
<1>6. Cardinality(AHK4) = 4
  BY <1>5a, MessageDomain, SMTT("r1")
<1>7. QED
  BY <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, SMTT("r2") DEF AHK1, AHK2, AHK3

LEMMA AHBagDomains ==
  \A B, S :
    /\ DOMAIN (B (+) SetToBag(S)) = (DOMAIN B) \cup S
    /\ DOMAIN (B (-) SetToBag(S)) \subseteq DOMAIN B
BY SMTT("r2") DEF (+), (-), SetToBag


LEMMA AHBoundMaximum ==
  \A n \in Nat : \A S \in SUBSET (0..n) : S # {} => SetMax(S) \in 0..n
<1>1. ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW S \in SUBSET (0..n), S # {}
      PROVE SetMax(S) \in 0..n
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(0..n) BY <1>1, FS_Interval, SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. IsFiniteSet(S) BY <1>1, <2>1, FS_Subset, SMTT("r1")
  <2>3. QED BY <1>1, <2>2, AHMaximum, SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA AHStep == AHInv /\ [Next]_vars => AHInv'
<1>1. ASSUME AHInv, [Next]_vars PROVE AHInv'
  <2>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AHInv, vars, protocolVars, serverVars, logVars,
       leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars,
       persistVars, historyVars
  <2>2. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, Timeout(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>2, AHMsgKinds, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, Timeout, SendAll, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>3. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, BecomeLeader(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>3, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r15")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, BecomeLeader, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>4. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, CompletePersistVote(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>4, AHMsgKinds, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, CompletePersistVote, Send, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>5. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, CheckLeaderLease(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>5, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, CheckLeaderLease, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>6. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, DiskBlock(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>6, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, DiskBlock, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>7. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, DiskUnblock(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>7, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, DiskUnblock, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>8. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, Crash(i) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>8, AHConfigFacts, SMTT("r15")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, Crash, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>9. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, AdvanceCommitIndex(i) PROVE AHInv'
    <3>1. (AHInv!1)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>2. (AHInv!2)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>3. (AHInv!3)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>4. (AHInv!4)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>5. (AHInv!5)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>6. (AHInv!6)'
      <4>1. committedConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat] /\ latestConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
        BY <1>1, SMTT("r1") DEF AHInv
      <4>2. QED BY <4>1, <2>9, SMTT("r2") DEF AdvanceCommitIndex
    <3>7. (AHInv!7)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>8. (AHInv!8)'
      BY <1>1, <2>9, AHConfigFacts, AHSeqFacts, AHBoundMaximum, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, AdvanceCommitIndex, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>9. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7, <3>8, SMTT("r1") DEF AHInv
  <2>10. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW value \in Values, ClientRequest(i, value) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>10, AHAppend, AHValueAppend, EntryDomain, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ClientRequest, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>11. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, ReplicateEntries(i,j) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>11, AHSeqFacts, AHEmpty, AHSubSeq, AHMsgKinds, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r15")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ReplicateEntries, Send, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>12. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, SendHeartbeat(i,j) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>12, AHEmpty, AHMsgKinds, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, SendHeartbeat, Send, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>13. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, ProposeConfigChange(i,j) PROVE AHInv'
    <3>1. (AHInv!1)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>2. (AHInv!2)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>3. (AHInv!3)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>4. (AHInv!4)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>5. (AHInv!5)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>6. (AHInv!6)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>7. (AHInv!7)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>8. (AHInv!8)'
      BY <1>1, <2>13, AHAppend, AHConfigAppend, AHSeqFacts, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AHInv, AHMessage, ProposeConfigChange, Min, Max,
          serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
    <3>9. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7, <3>8, SMTT("r1") DEF AHInv
  <2>14. ASSUME NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleRequestVoteRequest(m.mdest,m) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>14, AHMsgKinds, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, HandleRequestVoteRequest, Reply, Discard, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>15. ASSUME NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleRequestVoteResponse(m.mdest,m) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>15, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, HandleRequestVoteResponse, Reply, Discard, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2>16. ASSUME NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, HandleAppendEntriesRequest(m.mdest,m) PROVE AHInv'
    BY <1>1, <2>16, AHMerge, AHSeqFacts, AHConfigFacts, AHMsgKinds, AHBagDomains, SMTT("r15")
    DEF AHInv, AHMessage, HandleAppendEntriesRequest, Reply, Discard, LastLogIndex, Min, Max,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
